description: An ODELAYE2 on a high-range bank fails as one: no ODELAY there
exercises: an ODELAYE2 whose DATAOUT drives an OBUF on a high-range bank
pack_iologic() reaching get_odelay_site() for every output buffer type
why: Every output buffer on a high-range bank is an IOB33_OUTBUF (an OBUF and an OBUFT alike), and release 2026-10-16 binds an ODELAYE2 through DATAOUT only to an OUTBUF_DCIEN, the high-performance-bank buffer: the flow stops with 'unsupported cell type IOB33_OUTBUF', which reads like a netlist problem. openXC7/nextpnr e229044c lets the packer reach get_odelay_site(), which names the real limitation. The design stays unbuildable; this test holds the message.

log_contains: is located on a high range bank\. High range banks do not have ODELAY
